_note: pp_crm_guide.py: generic CRM guide (site/crm-guide/data/<slug>.json). Flows come from the master 'Snapshot Pool Profits' (published set = Southern's, minus per-account ones); texts get the client's own values. 'automations' = workflow → stage + plain event (pp_client_sheet logic: 'Right after …' / '1 day after …'); stage 'team' = only team alerts. 'team_what' = plain description of an alert step (fallback: first line of its text). Placeholders in journey/decisions/meeting_note: {business} {owner} {codes:<stage id>} {code:<workflow>/<step>} {when:<workflow>/<step>}.
meeting_note: Before we go live, we'll walk through how {business} will handle every lead, read every message your customers will get, and check off your part of the setup together.

stages.title: When you miss a call
stages.trigger_plain: Someone calls your business line and nobody answers

stages.title: When a lead goes quiet
stages.trigger_plain: You move the card to “No Response - Follow Up” (you called and couldn't reach them)

stages.title: After you send a quote
stages.trigger_plain: You move the card to “Quote Sent”

stages.title: When they miss an appointment
stages.trigger_plain: You move the card to “No Show” (your tech went out and nobody was home)

stages.title: When they become a customer
stages.trigger_plain: You move the card to one of the “Won” columns

stages.title: Asking for a review
stages.trigger_plain: Some time after a job is won, and when someone leaves you a Google review

stages.title: When a lead is lost
stages.trigger_plain: The card moves to “Lost” (by you, or after the follow-ups get no reply)

stages.title: Win-back campaigns (only when you start one)
stages.trigger_plain: You ask me to run a campaign to past customers or old leads

No Response Follow-up.event: you move the card to “No Response - Follow Up”

Quote Sent Follow-up.event: you move the card to “Quote Sent”

No-Show Follow-up.event: you move the card to “No Show”

Won Stage.event: you move the card to “Won - Weekly Pool Service”

when.Email - Send Review Request: Right after they rate you 4 or 5 in the rating text, or 7 days after the rating text if they haven't answered
when.SMS - Send Review Request: Right after they rate you 4 or 5 in the rating text, or 7 days after the rating text if they haven't answered

Review Response - Positive.event: they leave you a 4 or 5-star Google review

Review Response - Negative.event: they leave you a Google review of 3 stars or less

Website Form Fill To Pipeline.event: someone fills the form on your website

Answered Incoming Call To Pipeline.event: an answered call from a new number

team_what.Website Form Fill To Pipeline/New Lead S: Text with the lead's name, phone, email and city
team_what.Website Form Fill To Pipeline/Add Task: Task: follow up with the new web lead (call, then move the card)
team_what.Missed Incoming Call To Pipeline/Add Tas: Task: listen to the call recording and call them back
team_what.Answered Incoming Call To Pipeline/Add T: Task: listen to the call recording and confirm the next step on the card
team_what.SMS Customer Reply to pipeline/SMS Notif: Text with their name, phone and what they wrote
team_what.SMS Customer Reply to pipeline/App Notif: Alert in the app: “[First name] is waiting for your response”
team_what.Review Response - Negative/Add task: Urgent task: call them within 24 hours and try to make it right
team_what.Review Request/Notify Team - Negative Fe: Text with their rating and comment, so you can call before any review request goes out

team_when.Review Request/Notify Team - Negative Fe: A customer rates you 1–3 in the rating text

pipeline_plain.New Lead: A new call, text or website form. The card is created for you.
pipeline_plain.No Response - Follow Up: You tried and couldn't reach them. Move the card here and 3 friendly texts go out over about a week.
pipeline_plain.In Communication: You're talking with them. Nothing is sent. Cards also land here when a lead replies to a follow-up.
pipeline_plain.Scheduled: A visit or estimate is booked. Nothing is sent; it just keeps your board tidy.
pipeline_plain.Quote Sent: You sent a quote. If they don't reply, 2 follow-up texts go out.
pipeline_plain.No Show: Your tech went out and nobody was home. 2 texts ask them to reschedule.
pipeline_plain.Won - Weekly Pool Service: A new weekly customer. They get a welcome email and text, and a rating request later on.
pipeline_plain.Won - One Time Repair or Install: A repair or install job you won. A rating request goes out after the job.
pipeline_plain.Won - Pool Construction or Remodeling: A construction or remodel job you won. A rating request goes out after the job.
pipeline_plain.Recurring Customer: An ongoing customer. Nothing is sent.
pipeline_plain.Not Qualified Stage: Outside your area or not a fit. Nothing is sent.
pipeline_plain.Lost: They went another way. A short feedback email goes out, and a check-in after 90 days.
pipeline_plain.Spam: Spam or a wrong number. They're blocked from all messages.

journey.title: A new lead reaches you
journey.text: A call, text or website form becomes a card on your lead board, and {owner} gets an alert.

journey.title: You miss their call
journey.text: They get a text right away saying you'll call back, and a reminder 30 minutes later if they don't answer.

journey.title: You can't reach them
journey.text: Move the card to “No Response”: 3 friendly texts go out over about a week, then the card moves to Lost.

journey.title: You send a quote
journey.text: Move the card to “Quote Sent”: 2 follow-up texts go out if they don't reply.

journey.title: Nobody's home for the visit
journey.text: Move the card to “No Show”: 2 texts ask them to pick a new time.

journey.title: They say yes
journey.text: Move the card to the right “Won” column. New weekly customers get a welcome email and text.

journey.title: A few weeks later
journey.text: We ask how you did. 4–5 stars get your Google review link; 1–3 stars alert {owner} first.

journey.title: Lost leads and past customers
journey.text: Lost leads get a feedback email and a check-in after 90 days. Win-back texts go out only when you ask for a campaign.

decisions.question: If a lead goes quiet again later, should the follow-up texts start over when you move the card back to “No Response” or “Quote Sent”?
decisions.suggestion: Yes. They only start when you move the card, so you stay in control.

decisions.question: Should the first text after a missed call ({code:Missed New Lead - Initial SMS Follow-up/SMS 1}) end with “Reply STOP to opt out”?
decisions.suggestion: Yes, on that first text only. Phone carriers like to see it, and the other texts stay short.

decisions.question: Is the rating text ({code:Review Request/SMS - Request NPS Feedback}) timed right for your customers?
decisions.suggestion: Keep it as it is: {when:Review Request/SMS - Request NPS Feedback}. Tell me if your jobs need more or less time.

decisions.question: Is it OK if follow-up texts ({codes:no-response}, {codes:quote-sent}) go out on weekends?
decisions.suggestion: Yes, they're short check-ins. If you'd rather not, I'll hold them to Mon–Fri, 9am–5pm.

decisions.question: Weekly customers get a welcome email and text ({codes:won}). Do you want a welcome message for repair and construction jobs too?
decisions.suggestion: No for now. Their rating request already thanks them.
